# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 5 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 5
AnAO 5 (also written as AO5 or Administrative Officer Level 5) earns **$109,704–$119,018** gross — roughly $83,000–$89,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$123,000–$133,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 5 salary?
An Administrative AO 5 (also written as AO5 or Administrative Officer Level 5) earns $109,704 to $119,018 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
